mapper.select: SELECT * FROM person_lifecycle_pass WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_id = #{personId} AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY entered_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person_lifecycle_pass (workspace_id, person_id, entered_at, owner_id) SELECT #{workspaceId}, #{personId}, #{enteredAt}, person.owner_id FROM person WHERE person.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person.id = #{personId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE person_lifecycle_pass pass JOIN person ON person.workspace_id = pass.workspace_id AND person.id = pass.person_id SET pass.owner_id = CASE WHEN pass.qualified_at IS NULL AND pass.converted_at IS NULL AND pass.disqualified_at IS NULL THEN person.owner_id ELSE pass.owner_id END,
pass.qualified_at = COALESCE(pass.qualified_at, #{at}) pass.converted_at = COALESCE(pass.converted_at, #{at}) pass.disqualified_at = COALESCE(pass.disqualified_at, #{at})
WHERE pass.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pass.person_id = #{personId} AND pass.ended_at IS NULL

UPDATE person_lifecycle_pass pass JOIN person ON person.workspace_id = pass.workspace_id AND person.id = pass.person_id SET pass.ended_at = #{endedAt}, pass.owner_id = CASE WHEN pass.qualified_at IS NULL AND pass.converted_at IS NULL AND pass.disqualified_at IS NULL THEN person.owner_id ELSE pass.owner_id END WHERE pass.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pass.person_id = #{personId} AND pass.ended_at IS NULL
UPDATE person_lifecycle_pass SET owner_id = NULL WHERE owner_id = #{userId}

UPDATE person_lifecycle_pass pass JOIN person ON person.workspace_id = pass.workspace_id AND person.id = pass.person_id SET pass.first_response_started_at = person.first_response_started_at, pass.first_responded_at = person.first_responded_at, pass.first_response_due_at = person.first_response_due_at, pass.first_response_breached_at = person.first_response_breached_at WHERE pass.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pass.person_id = #{personId} AND pass.ended_at IS NULL AND person.suspended_at IS NULL AND person.provision_ceased_at IS NULL -- The clock must provably belong to this pass. A contact can be put under an SLA before it -- enters the lifecycle at all, and copying that clock onto a pass opened afterwards would -- credit the new lead with a response to the old one. AND person.first_response_started_at IS NOT NULL AND person.first_response_started_at >= pass.entered_at
